title: Production Deployment Topology and Deployment Runbook
objective: Establish a certifiable production deployment model for GLW and Genesis runtime dependencies
scope: Define production components environments services databases integrations ownership deployment flow verification checks and operational dependencies
exclusions: No architecture redesign no feature expansion no remediation outside deployment-readiness boundary
evidenceRequirements: Deployment topology diagram environment matrix ownership matrix deployment runbook pre-deploy checklist post-deploy verification checklist dependency map
validationRequirements: Review for completeness runbook walkthrough against current system boundaries traceability check to initial assessment gaps and blockers
exitCriteria: Deployment model and runbook approved with evidence complete and no unresolved critical ambiguity

title: Backup Restore and Disaster Recovery Certification
objective: Define and certify backup restore and DR controls including RTO and RPO
scope: Backup scope retention schedule restore procedures DR responsibilities failover assumptions and drill protocol
exclusions: No infrastructure redesign no implementation beyond approved readiness controls no unrelated operations changes
evidenceRequirements: Backup policy restore runbook DR plan RTO and RPO approval record and drill evidence template
validationRequirements: Validate policy completeness execute table-top or controlled drill validation review restore decision checkpoints
exitCriteria: Approved backup restore and DR package with ratified RTO/RPO and accepted drill protocol

title: Production Monitoring Alerting and Incident Response
objective: Define production health signals alerting responder model and incident operations
scope: Service health indicators logging and telemetry expectations alert thresholds escalation paths responder roles comms workflow
exclusions: No architecture change no tooling migration unrelated to certification objectives
evidenceRequirements: Monitoring and alert policy signal catalog alert routing model responder roster incident response runbook
validationRequirements: Validate signal-to-alert mapping verify escalation flow test incident-response workflow against representative failure scenarios
exitCriteria: Monitoring and incident package approved with complete responder model and validated escalation behavior

title: Production Rollback and Release Recovery
objective: Define certified release rollback and forward-recovery procedures across app and data boundaries
scope: Application rollback path database rollback or forward-recovery strategy failed deployment handling release verification and recovery evidence
exclusions: No release process redesign outside readiness scope no unrelated CI changes
evidenceRequirements: Rollback decision matrix release recovery runbook data recovery strategy verification checklist and evidence traceability
validationRequirements: Validate rollback and recovery paths via controlled rehearsal criteria and decision checkpoints
exitCriteria: Rollback and release recovery package approved with reproducible recovery path evidence

title: Performance Load and Scalability Certification
objective: Establish production performance baselines load readiness and scalability confidence
scope: Service-level baselines load scenarios acceptance thresholds capacity assumptions and scaling expectations
exclusions: No feature optimization campaigns no architecture change and no unrelated benchmark work
evidenceRequirements: Performance baseline report load-test plan scenario matrix acceptance thresholds and capacity model assumptions
validationRequirements: Validate benchmark reproducibility validate threshold attainment and document residual risk with mitigation options
exitCriteria: Performance and scalability package approved with evidence-backed capacity readiness

title: Security and Secrets Production Certification
objective: Certify production secrets handling and operational security controls
scope: Secrets lifecycle environment isolation access controls credential rotation operational security hardening and incident hooks
exclusions: No security architecture redesign no broad policy rewrite unrelated to production certification
evidenceRequirements: Secrets management model rotation schedule access review protocol security control checklist and operations hardening evidence
validationRequirements: Validate control ownership validate rotation and access procedures and verify coverage of production secrets and boundaries
exitCriteria: Security and secrets package approved with complete operational control evidence

title: Operational Readiness and Final Production Certification
objective: Consolidate completed package evidence and issue final production certification decision
scope: Final evidence consolidation cross-package traceability residual risk decision framing and final certification outcome
exclusions: No new remediation implementation only decision consolidation and certification issuance
evidenceRequirements: Consolidated evidence index final traceability matrix residual risk register and production certification decision report
validationRequirements: Validate closure of all required packages verify unresolved blocker disposition and verify decision traceability
exitCriteria: Final production certification decision issued with objective evidence and explicit conditions if any
